messages:
deploy-bot: starting rollout v3.9.0 -> canary (10%). change: streaming paging cursor compact encoding + client fragmentation optimization.

oncall_alex: getting paged-stream alerts. spike in cursor_deserialize errors, some customers seeing 5xx on paged streaming.

dana: confirmed in metrics. example log:
```
ERROR cursor_deserialize: unexpected EOF
 at streaming/cursor.go:118
 client=svc-frontend-12 host=canary-4
```

matt: I can repro with sdk v3.0 client talking to server v3.9.0 — failure during cursor decode when connection resumes mid-stream.

sdk_lead_jordan: the new compact cursor includes fragmentation flags to shrink token size. Sounds like older clients ignore the flag and fail.

sre-bot: INCIDENT OPENED — sev2 — paging-cursor-incompat — channel #incidents

oncall_alex: impact: ~12 customers touched; 3 customers with elevated errors and degraded UX. No data loss but timeouts and retries.

emily_cs: alerting affected customers now, short status note prepared.

dana: mitigation options: (1) flip feature flag paging_frag_compact=false (2) roll back canary (3) server-side dual-accept parsing shim.

matt: quick local FF toggle stops the errors. recommend kill-flag immediately for canary.

sdk_lead_jordan: agree, toggle FF. we'll prioritize a compatibility shim in next patch and add SDK parsing tests.

deploy-bot: TOGGLE: paging_frag_compact=false applied to canary group (10 hosts). verifying.

oncall_alex: watching metrics — errors drop within 90s. some long-lived connections still failing (will drain).

dana: enabling server parse-backward compatibility window for 5 minutes to accept both encodings while connections drain.

matt: initiating a conservative rollback of canary to v3.8.7 while we triage. creating rollback job.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK started for canary -> v3.8.7 (ETA ~3m).

sre-bot: HANDOFF: page-cursor-incompat. Primary: oncall_alex. Secondary: dana. Incident doc: https://rwd.internal/incidents/paging-cursor-1719904444

emily_cs: notified customers of rollback + mitigation steps. keeping message concise.

sdk_lead_jordan: action items: add server fallback parser + unit tests, extend compatibility matrix to SDK v2/v3, add cursor compatibility step to release checklist.

matt: will draft safe-rollout checklist and gating e2e streaming tests before next attempt.

anna_pm: blocking full rollout. postmortem owners: matt, jordan, dana. due in 48h.

oncall_alex: rollback complete on canary. baseline restored. marking incident mitigated; handing to night oncall (night_sre) for monitoring.

night_sre: acknowledged — will monitor for 6h and escalate if any recurrence.

sre-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED — paging-cursor-incompat. Resolution: FF kill + canary rollback. Postmortem required.

oncall_alex: closing thread once postmortem exists. thanks all. :thumbsup:
